top_choice_rationale: Biomolecular phase separation (Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen) establishes a general thermodynamic principle of intracellular organisation, with the P-granule demonstrations and multivalency reconstitutions reproduced widely; it is the clearest new concept of molecular organisation on the slate. I rank it first on scientific merit while acknowledging that the physiological extent of phase separation is still debated, the Pappu/Mittag cut costs credit, and that P001 (degradation with a narrow PROTAC citation) is my next choice and the stronger-supported option.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; amyloid and lipid-protein co-assembly work is scientifically adjacent to condensates, and Lund affiliation is shared with Linke and Somfai, flagged for transparency only
